mcqs.question: At what repo rate did the Reserve Bank of India pause its rate cuts in April 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The RBI paused its rate-cut cycle at a repo rate of 5.25% in April 2026, after cuts totalling about 125 basis points from early 2025. The rate of 6.50% refers to an earlier phase of monetary tightening, not the April 2026 pause.
